column1: # Maps rows of the ROADMAP.md "Progress at a glance" table to the issues that count as evidence for them.

# An issue counts when its "Roadmap ID" field matches the third column or its "Task ID" field matches the fourth.
# Rows that are not listed here (Method, Principles debates, Project name, Terminology) are never changed by automation.
